Ask a language model

Source: R/llm_native.R
llmask.Rd

Sends one prompt to the first language model that is set up on this machine and returns the reply. Bring your own key, or run a model locally: nothing is sent anywhere you did not set up. In order:

  1. your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint, MORIE_LLM_BASE_URL (with MORIE_LLM_API_KEY and MORIE_LLM_MODEL when it needs them), e.g. LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp or a company gateway. An https address, or plain http to the loopback host or to a literal private LAN address (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, fc00::/7: an LM Studio or vLLM box on your own network); a host name over plain http is refused. It is not probed, so a configured endpoint that is down is an error, not a silent hop elsewhere;

  2. a provider whose key is set (see llmprvd): OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter, Groq, Together, Fireworks, DeepSeek, Mistral, xAI, Cerebras, Perplexity, Hugging Face, OpenCode Zen, Cohere and NVIDIA, each through its own documented API with its own key variable (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, ...);

  3. a local Ollama server at OLLAMA_HOST, by default http://localhost:11434, with the model OLLAMA_MODEL or the first one pulled; OLLAMA_HOST=off skips it.

llmstat shows what is set up and which route a question would take.

Usage

llmask(
  prompt,
  model = NULL,
  tmout = 120,
  syspro = NULL,
  route = NULL,
  docs = TRUE,
  pkgs = NULL,
  fresh = FALSE
)

Arguments

prompt

Character scalar: the question, in plain text.

model

Character scalar or NULL (the default): the model id to use (a value shaped like a key is refused, never sent). NULL uses the route's own choice: MORIE_LLM_MODEL for your own endpoint, OLLAMA_MODEL or the first pulled model for Ollama, the saved PROVIDER.model or the provider's default model (see llmprvd).

tmout

Numeric scalar, seconds to wait for each reply; default 120. With docs = TRUE the whole exchange gets at most three times this.

syspro

Character scalar or NULL (the default): extra instructions sent as the system message (added to the package's own instructions when docs = TRUE).

route

Character scalar or NULL (the default: the saved route, else the first that is set up). "auto" uses the automatic order and ignores a saved route; "own", "ollama" or a provider id insists on that one.

docs

Logical scalar, default TRUE: give the model the packages' help and the lookup tools (see Details). FALSE sends the prompt alone.

pkgs

Character vector or NULL (the default): the installed packages whose help the model gets. NULL means "rmoriebricklayer", or the comma-separated list in the environment variable RMBL_PACKAGES (which a package built on this one sets for its own command line). Ignored when docs = FALSE.

fresh

Logical scalar, default FALSE. TRUE asks the model even when a saved answer matches (see Details), and saves the new answer in its place.

Value

A character scalar with the reply. A saved answer carries the time it was saved as attribute cached.

Details

With docs = TRUE (the default) the model is given the help of the packages named in pkgs (read from the help pages installed here) and may call five read-only tools before it answers: search_docs, get_help, get_examples, list_datasets and get_vignette. How much help goes into the instructions depends on the model's context size: a model with at least 32,000 tokens gets an index of every exported function (name, arguments, title) and up to six rounds of lookups; 8,000 to 32,000 tokens, the 120 functions nearest the question and four rounds; smaller, the 40 nearest and three rounds. A package with very many pages is never listed whole: its functions nearest the question are listed and the tools reach the rest. "Nearest" is a BM25 search over the help text in R (\(k_1 = 1.2\), \(b = 0.75\)). A model that cannot call tools gets the best matching pages in the prompt instead. Nothing the model asks for is run: it answers with code for you to run.

With docs = TRUE the whole exchange is given at most three times tmout; a lookup round that would start after that is not started and the call errors. With docs = FALSE one request is made with syspro (when given) and prompt.

Saved answers: a person at a terminal (the command line with a terminal on both stdin and stdout) or in an interactive GUI session gets a saved answer back at once when the question (spacing aside; case counts), route, address, model, packages and their versions, and syspro all match. Answers are kept as owner-only files in the folder that tools::R_user_dir() gives for "rmoriebricklayer" and "cache": for 30 days, which the option rmoriebricklayer.llmcachedays changes, and at most the 200 newest, which the option rmoriebricklayer.llmcachemax changes. The first save in a session says where answers go. Nothing is saved from a script, a pipeline, a test run, R CMD check, or with options(morie.quiet = TRUE). Saving is also turned off by MORIE_LLM_CACHE=off, or by the option rmoriebricklayer.llmcache set to FALSE.

Errors: prompt is not a single non-empty string; fresh or docs is not TRUE or FALSE; route = "hosted" or an unknown route; no route is set up (the message lists what to set); no model is chosen for the route; pkgs names a package that is not installed; and, after sending, an unreachable server, a rejected key (HTTP 401 or 403) or an error reply. The key is redacted from any error text a server echoes back.

See also

llmchat for a conversation without the help; llmstat and llmrte to see where a question would go.

Examples

old <- Sys.getenv(c("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "OLLAMA_HOST"), unset = NA)
Sys.setenv(XDG_CONFIG_HOME = tempfile(), OLLAMA_HOST = "off")

# arguments are checked before any route is resolved
try(llmask(c("two", "questions")))
#> Error : llmask: `prompt` must be a single non-empty string

# a provider named explicitly without its key
try(llmask("What is a capsule?", route = "anthropic"))
#> Error : no key for Anthropic: set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or `rmoriebricklayer config set anthropic.key` (it asks for the key)

# no route set up: the error lists what to set up
try(llmask("What is a capsule?", route = "ollama", docs = FALSE))
#> Error : No language-model route is set up on this machine: bring your own key, or run a model locally:
#>   local Ollama: OLLAMA_HOST=off
#> `rmoriebricklayer config setup` walks through it.

for (v in names(old)) {
  if (is.na(old[[v]])) Sys.unsetenv(v) else do.call(Sys.setenv, as.list(old[v]))
}
if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# needs your own key or a local model, and the network
Sys.setenv(ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "...")
llmask("What does a SHA-256 provenance record protect against?")
llmask("Explain an E-value of 2.1", route = "ollama")
llmask("Summarise Benford's law in two lines", docs = FALSE,
                   syspro = "You are terse.")
}
